primary_capture_policy: Existing exact bytes and original timestamps were reused. No new network retrieval is claimed. Search snippets, failed responses and GMO enrichment do not independently establish a product identity. The archived TOGO batch has a batch timestamp only, not an invented per-row retrieval time.
scientific_limits: All 61 complete case objects, 191 frozen recipe context records and all 39 whole payloads/before/predecessors were inspected. Long manufacturer documents were read at the relevant constituent/product sections, not every unrelated page. Owner catalogs were parsed completely with explicit mapped/unmapped globs including ignored files; unselected owner claims are not approved.
